allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: MPS Limited has informed the Exchange of the 5th Grant of Options Pursuant to 'MPS Limited- Employee Stock Options Scheme 2023'

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: We wish to inform you that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, 22 December 2025, has considered and approved the Grant of 28,906 Options under the "MPS Limited- Employee Stock Options Scheme 2023"

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: MPS Limited has informed the Exchange that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company in their meeting held today, 05 May 2025, has considered and approved the 3rd Grant of 58,900 options under MPS Limited-Employee Stock Options Scheme 2023.

allot.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
allot.text: MPS Limited has informed the Exchange about the Outcome of Board Meeting dated 28 February 2025, inter-alia, to consider and approve the proposal for capital raising in one or more tranches by way of issuance of Equity Shares and/or Equity Linked Securities.
